name: todo-manager help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:todo-manager. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Done / not done
entries.text: Shows “Done / not done”. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Add a subtask
entries.text: Adds a subtask. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Todo manager
entries.text: Shows the “Todo manager” part of this screen. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: New list
entries.text: Starts a new list. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Group by
entries.text: Where you set “Group by”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Show done
entries.text: Turns “Show done” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: List name
entries.text: Where you set “List name”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Rename group
entries.text: Renames group. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Delete group
entries.text: Deletes group. Depending on your behaviour theme it asks first. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Clear the selection
entries.text: Clears the selection. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Subtask of
entries.text: Where you set “Subtask of”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Subtask
entries.text: Shows “Subtask”. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Save as draft
entries.text: Saves as draft. Nothing is kept until you tap it. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Statuses
entries.text: Where you set “Statuses”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: New ones start as
entries.text: Where you set “New ones start as”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Priorities
entries.text: Where you set “Priorities”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Default priority
entries.text: Where you set “Default priority”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Add field
entries.text: Adds field. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Type
entries.text: Where you set “Type”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Options
entries.text: Where you set “Options”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Required
entries.text: Turns “Required” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Column in the grid
entries.text: Turns “Column in the grid” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Remove field
entries.text: Removes field. Depending on your behaviour theme it asks first. Part of Todo manager.

entries.title: Undo changes
entries.text: Undos changes. Part of Todo manager.
